### 1 — Scene
A mixed dinner plate: cooked chicken, sliced beef, broccoli, a small pepperoni pizza slice, roasted potato pieces, and a creamy dressed green salad.

### 2 — Vessel
A rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:
**Area = 3.14 × 13² = 531 cm².**

### 3 — Items
Visible foods are chicken with some browned coating, beef, broccoli, pepperoni-and-cheese pizza, browned potato pieces, and lettuce with creamy dressing and apparent grated cheese. No separate pool of oil is visible.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Dressing is an overlay on the salad, so its footprint is **not counted twice**. Estimates use cooked, as-plated energy values.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked chicken | 14% | 74 × 1.5 = 111 ml | 1.0 | 111 g | 200 | 222 kcal |
| Broccoli | 11% | 58 × 2.8 = 162 ml | 0.6 | 97 g | 35 | 34 kcal |
| Pepperoni pizza | 13% | 69 × 1.1 = 76 ml | 0.9 | 68 g | 290 | 197 kcal |
| Sliced beef | 15% | 80 × 1.3 = 104 ml | 1.0 | 104 g | 240 | 250 kcal |
| Roasted potato pieces | 6% | 32 × 1.8 = 58 ml | 0.6 | 35 g | 150 | 53 kcal |
| Salad greens | 24% | 127 × 3 = 381 ml | 0.18 | 69 g | 20 | 14 kcal |
| Creamy dressing with grated cheese | Overlay | 127 × 0.20 = 25 ml | 1.0 | 25 g | 420 | 105 kcal |

**Coverage check:** 14 + 11 + 13 + 15 + 6 + 24 = **83%**, consistent with a mostly covered plate.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **609 g and approximately 875 kcal**. This is plausible for the visible assortment: two portions of meat, a small pizza slice, vegetables, and rich salad dressing. Plate dimensions and dressing quantity are the largest uncertainties.
